Job Overview

Are you passionate about crafting high-quality hard surface models and realistic vehicles for AAA games? Wargaming Kyiv is looking for a talented 3D Artist to join our team and bring legendary armored vehicles to life in famous titles created by Wargaming. If you have a keen eye for detail, mastery in modeling, and a deep understanding of vehicle design, we want to hear from you!

What will you do?

• Create high-quality, photorealistic, and game-ready 3D models of armored vehicles, mechanical assets, props, and other hard-surface objects.
• Take assets through the full production pipeline, from high-poly modeling and detailing to low-poly, UVs, baking, texturing, optimization, and in-engine implementation.
• Work from blueprints, technical documentation, photographs, and real-world references to achieve a high level of accuracy and authenticity.
• Collaborate with artists and other development disciplines to ensure assets meet both visual and technical requirements.
• Continuously improve asset quality, workflows, and technical expertise while sharing knowledge with the team.

What are we looking for?

• 3+ years of experience in the game development industry as a 3D Artist.
• Strong hard surface modeling skills, particularly in vehicle creation and mechanical structures.
• Expertise in high-poly and low-poly modeling, UV mapping, and normal map baking.
• Solid understanding of PBR texturing workflows and materials.
• Proficiency in Maya, Substance Painter, ZBrush, and Photoshop.
• Ability to work from technical documents, blueprints, and real-world references.

What additional skills will help you stand out?

• Experience with Substance Designer, UVLayout, and Marvelous Designer.
• Hands-on experience with photogrammetry to enhance realism.
• Strong drawing or concepting skills to visualize ideas before modeling.

Work mode

• Remote (from anywhere within Ukraine).
• This role isn't eligible for relocation & immigration support.

Benefits

Benefits and perks are tailored to the local market and culture. Our benefits in Kyiv include:

• 24 business days of annual leave per calendar year
• 6 personal days per calendar year
• Career development and education opportunities within the company
• Premium Private Health Care (with wellness program option)
• Mental well-being program (iFeel)
• Life event bonuses (Employee’s Birthday, Marriage, Child’s Birth, etc.)
• English courses with 50% contribution
• Employee discounts
• Personal Gaming Account
• Coffee, fruits, and snacks in the office
• Company events
• Seniority Awards
• Referral program - You can recommend the best talents to the company and receive a reward

Please submit your CV in English to ensure smooth processing and review.
About Wargaming

Wargaming is an award-winning online game developer and publisher headquartered in Nicosia, Cyprus. Operating since 1998, Wargaming has become one of the leaders in the gaming industry with 15 offices worldwide, including studios in Chicago, Prague, Shanghai, Tokyo, and Vilnius. Our diverse and multicultural team works together to deliver a top-class experience to millions of players who enjoy Wargaming's titles across all major gaming platforms. Our flagship products include free-to-play hits World of Tanks, World of Warships and World of Tanks Blitz.
